description: This file contains implementation code for rewriting atomic counters in shader translation, including functions for declaring buffers, creating constants, and traversing AST nodes to replace atomic counter usage with storage buffer references.

classes.name: RewriteAtomicCountersTraverser
classes.description: AST traverser class that rewrites atomic counter variables and function calls to use storage buffers.

methods.name: DeclareAtomicCountersBuffers
methods.description: Declares a storage buffer array for atomic counters.

methods.name: CreateUIntConstant
methods.description: Creates a constant unsigned integer node.

methods.name: CreateAtomicCounterConstant
methods.description: Creates a constant struct for atomic counter binding and offset.

methods.name: CreateAtomicCounterRef
methods.description: Creates a reference to an atomic counter within the storage buffer.

methods.name: RewriteAtomicCounters
methods.description: Main function that applies the rewriting pass on the AST.
